acceptance_criteria.criterion: A command whose run function throws an error does not crash the interactive menu loop
The error message is printed to stdout via log()
After the error, the menu re-renders and the user can select another command

summary: Wrapped cmd.run([]) dispatch in showInteractiveMenu() with a try/catch block covering both sync and async branches.

In the catch handler, the error message is extracted (err.message if Error, String(err) otherwise) and printed via log() then waitForKey() is called so the user can read it before the menu re-renders.
Added import of log from '../colors.js' to interactive.ts.

Added 5 new tests in tests/menu/interactive.test.ts covering: sync error does not crash loop, async error does not crash loop, error message printed via stdout, waitForKey called after error, menu re-renders after error.

comments.note: No observations — code in the touched files is clean and consistent. The error handling integration was straightforward and the existing test infrastructure (buildKeypressController, mocked process.stdout.write) made the new tests easy to write without additional setup.
